summary: The UE 5.8 Niagara Fluids Grid3D FLIP Splash and continuous Hose templates both load, compile warm, activate, remain visible, occupy a bounded solver-contact volume, and coexist with a valid four-contact D4 wrap/pin/recovery state. With both broad live water and authored static water hidden, neither template renders a perceptible liquid body. The only visible white element is the existing production contact spray. Direct stock-template reuse is therefore rejected. The experimental runtime hook and capture-only controls were removed; production keeps the fail-closed V8 baseline.
